# Checklist: api
<!-- Generated by /speckit.checklist -->
<!-- Branch: 006-home-gamificada | Date: 2026-09-16 -->

No REST surface is added. What changes is the **choke point every read in the product goes
through**, plus two module contracts.

| ID | Check | Dimension | Ref | Status |
|----|-------|-----------|-----|--------|
| CHK036 | `FindArgs.select` is optional, so every existing caller compiles unchanged. Is "omitted means every field" the documented default, and is it written where `sort` and `page` document their own conditional spread? | [contract] | FR-030 | [ ] |
| CHK037 | What does Payload do when a `select` names a field that **does not exist** — throw, ignore, or return the row without it? A silent ignore turns a typo into a full-row read through a door built to prevent one | [validation] | FR-030 | [ ] |
| CHK038 | Does a `select` that omits `id` still return usable documents? The ranking needs a key per row, and `select` is exclusive — naming five fields may drop the sixth the renderer assumes | [contract] | FR-018, FR-030 | [ ] |
| CHK039 | `select` and `depth` interact: does selecting a relationship field still populate it at `depth: 1`, or does the projection cut it before population? `avatarRender` depends on the answer | [contract] | FR-019, FR-030 | [ ] |
| CHK040 | `readPublicRanking` for a lab with **no makers**: `[]` or `null`? FR-022 gives those two different meanings, and the card renders a different thing for each | [contract] | FR-017, FR-022 | [ ] |
| CHK041 | What does `readPublicRanking` **throw**? It reaches `getPublicScopedPayloadForRSC`, which throws `TenantUnresolvedError` for an unresolved host — does the reader let that through so the caller can `notFound()`, or swallow it? | [errors] | FR-025, FR-031 | [ ] |
| CHK042 | May a caller assume `readPublicRanking`'s order, or must it re-sort? If the order is part of the contract, the constant it shares with `/ranking` is part of the contract too | [contract] | FR-017, FR-021 | [ ] |
| CHK043 | After D3's split, which of the two mission modules may a test call **without a database**? The pure one must import nothing that reaches `next/headers`, or the "unit-testable" claim is false the first time it is run at `node` | [contract] | FR-007, D3 | [ ] |
| CHK044 | Does `lib/public/missoes.ts` export the union `EstadoPessoal` or re-export it from `lib/content/missoes.ts`? Two definitions of a four-way union is how the Home and `/missoes` end up disagreeing about `sem-perfil` | [consistency] | FR-007, D3 | [ ] |
| CHK045 | The band and `/missoes` both read missions but with different `where` and `limit`. Is that one function with parameters or two call sites? A shared reader whose caller passes the filter is a third place the status filter could be added by mistake | [contract] | FR-005, D4 | [ ] |
